unknown_commit.positive: Resolver reads exact stable operation ID and fingerprint through owner read port in authoritative store. Send requires complete transfer+typednotice result; claim requires frozen claim membership+all claimed transfer links+I5 receipt reference and semantic result. Never infer entire batch success from one Grant receipt alone.
unknown_commit.negative: Generic absence/missing row/unavailable lookup never authorizes replay; AllowReplayAfterAuthoritativeNegative:false. Return uncertainty when exact positive proof is unavailable.
unknown_commit.internal_replay: Same internal operation+same immutable fingerprint yields known committed result. Same operation different player/IDs/content fingerprint is conflict. New HTTP operation is not silently equivalent.
unknown_commit.w2: Nonce-less resubmission across day remains bounded ambiguity
